"Shifty" '''Panaw''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who lived in the dangerous region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] known as the [[Outlaw's Den]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He often traded scrap and other goods to those he encountered.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Panaw appears as a Black Market vendor in the Outlaw's Den, an open-world PvP zone on Tatooine in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
